flows.name: An AI agent answers a customer's email in the same thread (Primitive)
flows.summary: Primitive's case: customers and partners already email; connecting agents otherwise takes custom integration work business teams cannot maintain.

steps.what: Emails one of the company's addresses with a question or an order.
Delivers the email into the company's systems as a structured message, or runs a handler Primitive hosts; webhook deliveries are signed so the company can verify them.
Handles the message; the agents and AI models stay the company's own.
steps.agent: Reads the email and decides the reply.

steps.what: Replies in the same thread, from the company's own domain or one Primitive provides.
Runs the mail servers and manages SPF, DKIM and DMARC; outbound mail is signed and authenticated, traffic uses TLS, and each organisation's mail is kept apart.
